name: rentalbench
description: Manage an existing RentalBench rental business across one or multiple locations from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect an existing RentalBench staff account to manage rental operations in ChatGPT. Work across your accessible locations with inventory, rental units, consumable stock, customers, addresses, orders, reservations, checkout, returns, inspections, documents, comments, imports, custom fields, webstores, domains, team access and settings. Your existing staff permissions, location access and plan limits apply. Passwords, sign-in changes, bank account setup and returns requiring online deposit refunds use authenticated RentalBench pages. Subscription checkout, domain purchases and new charge initiation are excluded. Published storefront changes and customer communications occur only through the corresponding requested actions.
defaultPrompt: Show my locations and help me plan today's rentals and returns.
Check inventory and bookings at my selected location.
Help me create and manage a rental order for an existing customer.
